definitions.explanation: A place where hair is cut, styled, colored, or permed. In Japan, distinct from a barbershop.

examples.japanese: {美容室|びようしつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{予約|よやく}した→予約する：22989_yoyakusuru⟧。
examples.english: I made an appointment at the hair salon.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{美容室|びようしつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦オープン→オープン：10831_oopun⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A new beauty salon opened in front of the station.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎月|まいつき}→毎月：00732_maitsuki⟧⟦{一回|いっかい}→一回：08925_ikkai⟧{美容室|びようしつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{通|かよ}っている→通う：01217_kayou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{今月|こんげつ}→今月：00720_kongetsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{忙|いそが}しくて→忙しい：00591_isogashii⟧⟦{行|い}けなかった→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I go to the beauty salon once a month, but this month I was too busy to go.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{美容|びよう}→美容：00014_biyou⟧ (beauty, cosmetics) + ⟦{室|しつ}→室：09946_shitsu⟧ (room). In Japan, {美容室|びようしつ} and ⟦{理髪店|りはつてん}→理髪店：06320_rihatsuten⟧/⟦{床屋|とこや}→床屋：01682_tokoya⟧ (barbershop) are legally and culturally distinct. {美容室|びようしつ} are licensed to cut and style hair, offer perms and coloring, and serve both men and women. The more casual synonym ⟦{美容院|びよういん}→美容院：06319_biyouin⟧ is also very common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {美容室|びようしつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧: to go to the hair salon
- {美容室|びようしつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{予約|よやく}する→予約する：22989_yoyakusuru⟧: to book a salon appointment
- {美容室|びようしつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{通|かよ}う→通う：01217_kayou⟧: to go regularly to a salon
- {美容室|びようしつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{髪|かみ}→髪：02196_kami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{切|き}る→切る：02693_kiru⟧: to get a haircut at a salon
- {美容室|びようしつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{染|そ}める→染める：04253_someru⟧: to get hair colored at a salon

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{美容院|びよういん}→美容院：06319_biyouin⟧: beauty salon — virtually synonymous, equally common
- ⟦{床屋|とこや}→床屋：01682_tokoya⟧: barbershop — traditionally for men, more casual atmosphere
- ⟦{理髪店|りはつてん}→理髪店：06320_rihatsuten⟧: barbershop — formal word for barber
- ヘアサロン: hair salon — loanword, used by trendy or upscale shops
